questions.question: Which endocrine gland produces and secretes the hormone Calcitonin to regulate blood calcium levels?
questions.hint: Parafollicular C-cells of the Thyroid gland secrete calcitonin.

questions.question: In human cardiac cycle, which heart valve prevents the backflow of blood from the aorta into the left ventricle?
questions.hint: Aortic valve prevents regurgitation into the left ventricle.

questions.question: During DNA Replication, which enzyme unwinds the double helix by breaking hydrogen bonds between nitrogenous bases?
questions.hint: Helicase unwinds the double-stranded DNA structure.
